description: Attaches a file that was already uploaded (a Notion file_upload ID) as a block to a Notion page or parent block. Use it after upload_large_file_to_notion, or to retry a failed attachment without uploading again.

blockId.description: The Notion page ID or parent block ID where the file should be appended.

blockType.description: The block type to create for the file.

caption.description: Optional text caption to display beneath the file block in Notion.

fileUploadId.description: The Notion file_upload ID returned by an upload tool.

name: attach_file_upload_to_notion
